70533.synopsis: Universes collide and the Multiverse Saga begins its final chapter in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and ultimately face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered. This epic film will lay the foundation for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
70533.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

71218.title: Clayface
71218.synopsis: CLAYFACE unravels one man's horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one's identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.
71218.cast: David Dencik, Naomi Ackie, Tom Rhys Harries

72478.title: Disney's Hexed
72478.synopsis: In Hexed, an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino.

76536.title: The Cat in the Hat
76536.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT, voiced by Bill Hader, comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.
76536.cast: Bill Hader, Paula Pell, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez

77032.title: Dune: Part Three
77032.synopsis:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion. 

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

77249.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
77249.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
77249.cast: Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada, Ralph Fiennes

77282.title: Violent Night 2
77282.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.
77282.cast: David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell

77575.title: The Comeback King
77575.synopsis:
The film, about a country western star in free fall, is set to star Glen Powell and Cristin Milioti. Judd Apatow will direct. Apatow and Powell wrote the script together.

Apatow will produce through his longstanding Apatow Productions overall deal with the Studio. Apatow's relationship with the Studio dates back to his 2005 directorial debut, The 40-Year-Old Virgin, and he has since directed Knocked Up, Funny People, This is 40, Trainwreck and The King of Staten Island for the Studio.

Powell and Dan Cohen will produce through Barnstorm's first look deal with the Studio. Powell's relationship with the Studio originates with his starring role in Twisters, which overperformed against all industry expectations, becoming the biggest opening for a natural disaster film ever at the domestic box office and grossing $267.8 million overall in the domestic box office.

Kevin Misher will produce through Misher Films. Misher has a storied history with Universal Pictures, where he was President of Production from 1996-2001 and supervised production for some of the Studio's most acclaimed features, including Erin Brockovich, The Fast and the Furious, Meet the Parents, and The Mummy. Misher subsequently formed Misher Films, where he has been producing a variety of films over the past two decades, including Fighting With My Family, Coming 2 America and You People.

78770.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
78770.synopsis: "Ice Age: Boiling Point” is a dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure that takes Manny (voiced by Ray Romano), Sid (voiced by John Leguizamo), Diego (voiced by Denis Leary), Ellie (voiced by Queen Latifah), Buck (voiced by Simon?Pegg), acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat –?and the rest of the herd to visit never-before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World. The film is directed by John C. Donkin, produced by Lori Forte, and releases exclusively in theaters February 5, 2027.

79095.title: Children of Blood and Bone
79095.synopsis: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award®  nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award®  winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award®  winner Viola Davis.

79305.title: Werwulf
79305.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

79564.title: Focker In-Law
79564.synopsis: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.
79564.cast: Ariana Grande, Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro

79935.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ
79935.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.
79935.cast: Ben Mendelsohn, Deva Cassel, Gael Garcia Bernal, Sam Worthington

80290.title: How to Rob a Bank
80290.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
80290.cast: Anna Sawai, Nicholas Hoult, Zoe Kravitz

81078.title: Star Wars (1977)
81078.cast: Alec Guinness, Carrie Fisher, Harrison Ford, Mark Hamill

81142.title: The Third Parent
81142.synopsis: Based on the viral "creepypasta" series of internet-based stories from writer Elias Witherow, The Third Parent takes place amidst a Fourth of July celebration when a disturbing figure named Tommy Taffy emerges, disguising himself as a human to infiltrate a suburban neighborhood and impose authoritarian rule over an unsuspecting family.

81846.title: Cliffhanger
81846.synopsis: Haunted by a devastating climbing accident, Naomi (Lily James) must turn treacherous peaks, sheer cliffs, and deadly terrain into her greatest weapon in a relentless fight to save her family (Pierce Brosnan, Nell Tiger Free) from kidnappers.
81846.cast: Lily James, Nell Tiger Free, Pierce Brosnan

81938.title: Ebenezer
81938.synopsis: This November, prepare to be ghosted. Johnny Depp is the deliciously unpleasant Ebenezer Scrooge in a thrilling reimagining of the most iconic ghost story of all time. On one unforgettable Christmas Eve, Ebenezer collides with his past, present, and future on a supernatural journey that will decide his ultimate fate. If you think you know his story, think again. Directed by Ti West and with a screenplay by Nathaniel Halpern, Ebenezer also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

82072.title: CoComelon: The Movie
82072.synopsis:
The CG animated feature, inspired by the global children's phenomenon CoComelon, is produced by Moonbug Entertainment, Flywheel Media, Prime Focus Studios, and DreamWorks Animation, with animation by the DNEG Group. The film is directed by acclaimed animation filmmaker Kat Good (Tarzan, Mulan, Kung Fu Panda), with Grammy-nominated, multi-platinum songwriter and producer Justin Tranter serving as Executive Music Producer. 

Created exclusively for the theatrical experience, the big-screen adventure invites families to experience the world of CoComelon like never before, following JJ and his friends on a sweeping cinematic journey filled with rich storytelling and original music that will captivate audiences when the film premieres in theaters on February 19, 2027.

82570.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
82570.synopsis:
War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

82608.title: Wife & Dog
82608.synopsis: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates fuels betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

82629.title: Wildwood
82629.synopsis: It follows a girl?s desperate quest to save her baby brother, which becomes a high-stakes journey into a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, unlikely allies and formidable adversaries, where an entire hidden realm hangs in the balance.
82629.cast: Carey Mulligan, Jacob Tremblay, Peyton Elizabeth Lee

82697.title: The Beekeeper 2
82697.synopsis: Now a wanted man, former government assassin Adam Clay continues his vendetta against those who wronged him.

82739.title: I Play Rocky
82739.synopsis: The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky--he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.
82739.cast: Annasophia Robb, Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon

82779.title: The Maltese Falcon 85th Anniversary
82779.synopsis: Academy Award winner Humphrey Bogart stars in this classic film noir as tough San Francisco private detective Sam Spade in the classic, convoluted story of Spade?s involvement with a deadly band of international thieves who will lie, double cross and murder to obtain a small, jewel-encrusted statue known as The Maltese Falcon.
82779.cast: Gladys George, Humphrey Bogart, Mary Astor

82788.title: It's a Wonderful Life 80th Anniversary
82788.synopsis: Embraced as a cherished holiday tradition by families around the world, Frank Capra?s heart-warming masterpiece now celebrates 75 years with this big-screen event. George Bailey (James Stewart) sets aside his dreams of world travel to run his father?s small community bank, and protect the people of Bedford Falls from greedy businessman Mr. Potter (Lionel Barrymore). When a costly mistake pushes George to the brink of despair, a visit from a kindly angel (Henry Travers) will show George how the life of one good man can change the world forever.
82788.cast: Donna Reed, James Stewart, Lionel Barrymore

82828.title: Air Bud Returns
82828.synopsis: A grieving 12-year-old boy finds his dad?s old VHS tape and befriends a golden retriever in his new year.  Together, they chase basketball dreams, rally underdogs, and discover what it means to play with heart.
82828.cast: Edwin Lee Gibson, Tracy Ifeachor, Tyler Labine

82880.title: The Rescue
82880.synopsis: A former rodeo cowboy (Brandon Sklenar) takes matters into his own hands when his daughter is kidnapped for ransom. With her devoted dog by his side, he sets out to bring her home and will stop at nothing to find her.
82880.cast: Brandon Sklenar, Hassie Harrison, Josh Lucas

82937.title: Wild Horse Nine
82937.synopsis: In 1973 Chile, CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing journey from Santiago to Easter Island.

83683.title: November 1963
83683.synopsis: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.
83683.cast: Dermot Mulroney, John Travolta, Robert Carlyle

83726.title: Hershey
83726.synopsis:
Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. 

Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton's wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America's children in need.

83830.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
83830.synopsis: Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Greta Gerwig brings C. S. Lewis's beloved story The Magician's Nephew to the screen for the first time in a sweeping adventure that invites dreamers of all ages to experience the creation of Narnia.
83830.cast: Beatrice Campbell, David McKenna, Emma Mackey

83930.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila (2026)
83930.synopsis: Sacred, scandalous, and irresistibly alluring, Saint-Saens's spectacular take on the biblical hero of legendary strength and the seductive Philistine whose beauty overpowers him returns in the Met's larger-than-life production. Featuring a massive orchestra and chorus and some of opera's most spellbinding tunes, this masterpiece of French grand opera is a feast for the eyes and ears. Giacomo Sagripanti conducts an electrifying cast led by the formidable star pairing of mezzo-soprano Aigul Akhmetshina and tenor Clay Hilley, transmitted live to cinemas worldwide.
83930.cast: Aigul Akhmetshina, Clay Hilley, Quinn Kelse

83933.title: Lice
83933.synopsis: A parasitic outbreak hits a Long Island high school in the 1980s, leading to military quarantine. When the school goes under lockdown, the itch-crazed students turn on each other in a desperate struggle to survive.
83933.cast: Emile Hirsch, Justin Long, Kevin Connolly

83951.title: Fing!
83951.synopsis: Librarians Mr. and Mrs. Meek indulge their demanding daughter Myrtle's every wish. When she wants a Fing, they search deep in the jungle. After finding one, Myrtle faces off against a Viscount who wants the rare creature.
83951.cast: Iona Bell, Penelope Wilton, Taika Waititi

83952.title: Above the Below
83952.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.

84024.title: Good Vibes Only
84024.synopsis: Fanny and Tom have been happily married for 20 years. When it's revealed Fanny has never had an orgasm, engineer Tom sets out to invent a device to revolutionize female pleasure. The couple embarks on a wild yet touching journey.

84029.title: Lords of War
84029.synopsis: Nicolas Cage reprises his role as Yuri Orlov, the world's most notorious arms dealer, who discovers he has a son, a ruthless mercenary bent on surpassing his father by building a private army and exploiting America's wars in the Middle East. Thrust into a deadly battle for legacy, their fierce rivalry is fueled by power, ambition, and betrayal - with the global arms trade hanging in the balance.

84084.title: Wishful Thinking
84084.cast: Amita Rao, Lewis Pullman, Maya Hawke

84118.title: Flavia Girl Detective
84118.synopsis: Amateur detective. Master poisoner. Eleven years old. When Flavia finds a dead body at her family's decaying British manor house and her father is accused of murder, she dives into her own wild and fearless investigation, unearthing long-held family secrets and pitting herself against the true murderer. A little genius goes a long way. Based on the internationally renowned and New York Times bestselling The Flavia de Luce mystery book series.
84118.cast: Jonathan Pryce, Martin Freeman, Molly Belle Wright

84173.title: Slayground
84173.synopsis: Scare-actor "Metal Mike" Graves wakes up in a haunted attraction surrounded by the dead bodies of his co-workers with no memory of how they got there. As a state-wide manhunt closes in, he races to uncover the truth - even if the trail leads straight back to him.
84173.cast: Chase Sui Wonders, Cory Michael Smith, Sophie Wilde

84178.title: Karoshi
84178.synopsis: From producer Chad Stahelski (John Wick franchise), and written and directed by Takashi Doscher, KAROSHI is an action-thriller set in a near-future Manhattan, where corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface. Starring Teo Yoo (Past Lives), Isabel May (Scream 7), Takehiro Hira ("Sh?gun"), Bill Camp ("Presumed Innocent"), Show Kasamatsu ("Tokyo Vice"), Giancarlo Esposito ("Breaking Bad"), and Cynthia Erivo (Wicked). Produced by Jason Spitz, Alex Young, and Nathan Kahane.
84178.cast: Isabel May, Takehiro Hira, Teo Yoo

84204.title: The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth
84204.synopsis: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Quentin Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. In THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, directed by David Fincher from a new script by Tarantino, the fairytale is over. Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good. He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Carla Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Matt Groove and JB Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairytale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA. Discover whether the further adventures — or mis-adventures — of Cliff Booth end happily ever after on November 25 in IMAX at AMC.
84204.cast: Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan

84278.title: MET Opera: La Fanciulla del West (2027)
84278.synopsis: Puccini's exhilarating drama of the Wild West returns in a new staging by celebrated British director Richard Jones, marking the company's first new production of La Fanciulla del West in more than 30 years. Soprano Vida Miknevici?t? makes an important Met debut as the larger-than-life Minnie, the tough tavern owner with a heart of gold who finds love when she least expects it. Tenor SeokJong Baek is the dashing bandit who rambles into the remote California mining town to steal her heart, opposite baritone Christopher Maltman as the lawman determined to deliver rough justice--and win Minnie for himself. Maestro Keri-Lynn Wilson takes the podium to conduct one of opera's most action-packed adventures, live from the Met stage to cinemas worldwide.

84291.title: MET Opera: Magic Flute Holiday Encore (2026)
84291.synopsis: The Met made history in December 2006 when it presented its first Live in HD transmission to movie theaters worldwide ?the abridged English-language version of Mozart?s The Magic Flute. This holiday season, the opera returns to select movie theaters in a special encore presentation.

84298.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila Encore (2026)

84299.title: MET Opera: La Fanciulla del West Encore (2027)

84308.title: Paper Tiger
84308.synopsis: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.

84315.title: Drag
84315.synopsis: Two burglars face disaster during a simple home heist when one suffers a back injury.  As the clock ticks and pain sets in, their escape becomes increasingly chaotic before the owner's return.
84315.cast: John Stamos, Lizzy Kaplan, Lucy Devito

84334.title: ENE Repeat
84334.synopsis: ENE REPEAT reunites a close-knit group of friends as they embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.
84334.cast: Abhinav Gomatam, Maganti Srinath, Vishwak Sen

84341.title: The Choice
84341.synopsis: THE CHOICE is a documentary about survival, grief, forgiveness, and the extraordinary human capacity to choose hope in the face of devastation.

84351.title: Coward
84351.synopsis: Set at the height of World War I in the shadows of the Belgian trenches, Lukas Dhont's COWARD unfolds as an epic, intimate journey of youthful self discovery through love, art, and survival. Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?

84355.title: Minotaur
84355.synopsis: Intrigue, corruption, betrayal, survival: the walls of the maze are closing in. The latest from Academy Award nominated writer-director Andrey Zvyagintsev (Loveless, Leviathan), Cannes Grand Prix winner MINOTAUR is a twist-laden parable for our times. Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful. At work, he contends with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine. Desperate to keep his hands clean, Gleb struggles to reassert control even as the collapse of his carefully ordered life seems fated to accelerate toward violence. A pressure cooker in cinematic form, MINOTAUR uncovers and indicts the heart of societal darkness with searing clarity. Uniting intimately-drawn performances and stark visual power, this is peerless work from an indisputable master.

84366.title: La Bola Negra
84366.synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA is a bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history from the 30s to modern day. The film tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance.

84449.title: The Debut
84449.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
84449.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

84456.title: Japon - lumiere d'automne - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84456.synopsis: Immerse yourself in the heart of a fascinating country where ancient traditions and modernity coexist in perfect harmony. From bustling metropolises like Tokyo to serene places like Kyoto, this journey unveils the many facets of the Japanese archipelago. Through encounters and discoveries, the film leads us to iconic sites steeped in history and emotion, such as Hiroshima and the sacred island of Miyajima, as well as to more peaceful regions, including the majestic landscapes of the Japanese Alps. Between ancient temples, ultramodern cities, and breathtaking panoramas bathed in the colors of autumn, our adventurers Serge and Johanne offer a sensitive and authentic perspective on Japan.

84493.title: Club Kid
84493.synopsis: An organizer of underground parties is forced to take care of a son whose existence he was completely unaware of.
84493.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.
84493.cast: Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva, Miss Benny

84501.title: Tender Loving Care
84501.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
84501.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

84503.title: The Liberation
84503.synopsis: Rita (Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. But when her daughters Ella (Ramsey) and Jo (Young) arrive unexpectedly and become drawn into the group's seductive world, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her.
84503.cast: Bella Ramsey, Carrie Coon, Lily James

84505.title: Behemoth!
84505.synopsis: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
84505.cast: Eva Victor, Olivia Wilde, Pedro Pascal

84514.title: Clarissa
84514.synopsis: Based on Mrs. Dalloway. Follows a Lagos society wife preparing for a party while reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend.
84514.cast: Ayo Edebiri, David Oyelowo, Sophie Okonedo

84564.title: Bitter Christmas
84564.synopsis: BITTER CHRISTMAS tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raul, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raul's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.
84564.cast: Aitana Sanchez-Gijon, Barbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Victoria Luengo

84567.title: INDE les Mysteres du Gange - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84567.synopsis: After captivating audiences with their Italian saga, Michele and Martin radically change scenery to immerse themselves in the intensity of Northern India. From the vibrant energy of Delhi to the sacred banks of the Ganges, and on to the breathtaking panoramas of the Himalayas, they reveal an India that is both vibrant and profoundly human. Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.

84602.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
84602.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience.

84621.title: Hurricanna
84621.synopsis: In the hours surrounding a glamorous appearance at a championship boxing match, supermodel Anna Nicole Smith, her psychiatrist, and her lover form a disastrous trio and descend towards chaos.
84621.cast: Holly Hunter, Mark Duplass, Sylvia Hoeks

84636.title: Elsinore
84636.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.
84636.cast: Andrew Scott, Billie Piper, Olivia Colman

84698.title: If You Should Leave Before Me
84698.synopsis: A devastating loss drives a rift between Mark and Joshua after many years of marital bliss. To avoid coping with their grief, they immerse themselves in their work ... which just so happens to be guiding the recently deceased to the afterlife.
84698.cast: John Wilcox, Merrick McCartha, Shane P. Allen

84718.title: King
84718.synopsis: A deadly assassin navigates the underworld while confronting high-stakes emotional conflicts and a romantic relationship.

84722.title: Avengers: Doomsday RealD 3D Fan Event
84722.synopsis: Join us on December 20 for a special RealD 3D Fan Event screening of Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Every guest receives a pair of collectible 3D glasses featuring one of five mystery logos. Which universe will you represent: The Avengers, Black Panther, X-Men, Fantastic Four, or the elusive Dr. Doom. Which pair will you get?
84722.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

84741.title: Ink
84741.synopsis: The film is based on the Tony-nominated play by multi-Olivier award-winning playwright and screenwriter James Graham. The film is an explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news -- one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.
84741.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

84758.title: Witch on the Holy Night
84758.synopsis:
Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl's story -- the tale of a Witch.
84758.cast: Haruka Tomatsu, Kana Hanazawa, Yusuke Kobayashi

84768.title: Dune: Part Three Insider Screenings
84768.synopsis: THE JOURNEY TO ARRAKIS BEGINS. This early showing is intended for Dune Insiders—fans who have opted into the film’s official Insider program for a direct connection to the campaign, including updates, special content and more.

84786.title: Gradiva, La
84786.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. The trip becomes a rare moment when the force of youth meets a world frozen in time. Their desires start to surface with unexpected intensity, leading them toward an irreversible fracture.

84862.title: Kristina Kuzmic - Hope & Humor
84862.synopsis: Kristina Kuzmic's HOPE & HUMOR comedy special blends hilarious chaos with pure heart. Mom life or mental health, trendy slip-ons or well-loved slippers, Kristina reaffirms that laughing (or pouring wine over your ice cream) beats crying in a closet.

84880.title: Josephine
84880.synopsis: After 8-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she acts out in search of a way to regain control of her safety, while adults are helpless to console her.
84880.cast: Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Mason Reeves, Philip Ettinger

84926.title: Trial of Hein
84926.synopsis: After 14 years, Hein returns to his island village, but the community doesn't recognize him and demands a trial to prove his identity.
84926.cast: Emilia Schule, Paul Boche, Philip Froissant

84989.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
84989.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
84989.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

84991.title: Ramayana
84991.synopsis:
Hindi with English Subtitles. Based on the celebrated ancient epic known to billions, Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend tells the story of Rama, a prince bound by sacrifice; Ravana, an immortal king driven by vengeance; and the prophecy that binds their fates together. It stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi. 

The film is produced by acclaimed filmmaker Namit Malhotra, whose Academy Award®-winning visual effects company DNEG has worked on films including The Odyssey, Dune, Interstellar, and Inception; directed by Nitesh Tiwari, whose film Dangal remains the highest-grossing Indian film worldwide; and scored by Academy Award® winners Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman. Namit Malhotra's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend will be released globally in theaters in time for Diwali on November 5.

84997.title: Rose
84997.synopsis:
We only imagine and invent ourselves. 

Oscar nominee Sandra Huller (Anatomy of a Fall, The Zone of Interest) takes on her most powerful role yet in ROSE, writer-director Markus Schleinzer's transcendent new film. 

In 17th century Germany, a mysterious soldier arrives in an isolated village, laying claim to an abandoned farmstead with the intent to settle down. Unbeknownst to the residents, this outsider is Rose, born a woman yet living as a man. Upon moving in and resolutely taming the land, he realizes the sole way to secure his position is to marry into the community. Yet taking a wife (Caro Braun) gives rise to suspicions even as they grow close, propelling events towards a reckoning.

Meticulously rendered in stunning black-and-white, ROSE transports us to a world unlike any other to convey the universal value of personal freedom. In her Silver Bear-winning star turn, Sandra Huller embodies a self-defining protagonist whose profound fluidity and humanity resonates through the past and into the present. Matching this emphatic performance with exquisite technique, Austria's Best International Feature Film entry to the 99th Academy Awards is a boundary-breaking fable from a true craftsman.

85018.title: Artificial
85018.cast: Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Yura Borisov

85072.title: Elf
85072.synopsis: A human baby raised as an elf. A city where no one remembers the true meaning of Christmas. Will Ferrell (Saturday Night Live, Superstar) stars as Buddy, a human raised in the North Pole to be an elf. After wreaking havoc in the elf community due to his size, Buddy heads to New York City to find his place in the world, and track down his father. But life in the big city is not all sugarplums and candy canes. His father is a 'Scrooge' and his eight-year-old stepbrother doesn't believe in Santa. Even the snowmen aren't friendly in New York. In fact, they don't even speak. Worst of all, everyone has forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and it's up to Buddy and his simple elf ways to win over his family, realize his destiny and, ultimately, save Christmas for New York and the world. Directed by John Favreau (Swingers), Elf is a warm-hearted Christmas comedy written by David Berenbaum.

85073.title: The Polar Express
85073.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

85074.title: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas
85074.synopsis: The curmudgeonly recluse Grinch, who hates Christmas, becomes annoyed with the out-of-control Christmas festivities in Whoville, the town lying below his cave dwelling on Mt. Crumpit. But after the Grinch conspires to deprive the Who's of their favorite holiday by sneaking into town on Christmas eve to steal everything associated with the holiday, he learns that the spirit of Christmas goes much deeper than tinsel and toys.

85075.title: Love Actually (HFS26)
85075.synopsis: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

85076.title: Bad Santa
85076.synopsis: Two con men masquerade as Santa Claus and an elf, knocking off shopping malls. But then they meet an 8-year-old boy, who unintentionally reminds them about the true meaning of Christmas.

85077.title: Gremlins
85077.synopsis: With its Christmas lights and dusting of snow, Kingston Falls is an idyllic small town--until the gremlins take over. A father returns from Chinatown with an unusual pet, a Mogwai--a gift for his son. The rules are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never--never--feed him after midnight. But the rules are inadvertently broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

85078.title: Scrooged
85078.synopsis: High-spirited high jinks on Christmas Eve put Frank Cross (Bill Murray) in a ghostly time warp in this hilarious take-off of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol. Cross, who has made the meteoric rise from the depths of the mail room to TV network president, is mean, nasty, uncaring, unforgiving and has a sadistic sense of humor - perfect qualities for a modern-day Scrooge. Before the night is over, he'll be visited by a maniacal New York cab driver from the past, a present-day fairy who’s into pratfalls and, finally, a ghoulish, seven-foot headless messenger from the future.

85086.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
85086.synopsis: Baba Segis three wives have learned to share his wealth, his bed, and his secrets. But when an educated fourth wife arrives with a hidden past, the fragile balance of the household begins to unravel, exposing betrayals, buried truths, and a scandal that threatens to destroy the family.
85086.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

85107.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow!
85107.synopsis: Known to millions as `The King of Waltz?, Andre Rieu is the world?s leading pop classical artist and consistently appears on the worldwide list of highest-grossing touring artists.

85142.title: You Can See Everything
85142.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

85177.title: Ebenezer: Sensory Friendly Screening
85177.synopsis: This November, prepare to be ghosted. Johnny Depp is the deliciously unpleasant Ebenezer Scrooge in a thrilling reimagining of the most iconic ghost story of all time. On one unforgettable Christmas Eve, Ebenezer collides with his past, present, and future on a supernatural journey that will decide his ultimate fate. If you think you know his story, think again. Directed by Ti West and with a screenplay by Nathaniel Halpern, Ebenezer also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

85178.title: Violent Night 2: Sensory Friendly Screening
85178.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.

85179.title: Disney's Hexed: Sensory Friendly Screening
85179.synopsis: In Hexed, an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino.

85251.title: Dada
85251.synopsis: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

85274.title: January 12 Vidudala
85274.synopsis:
Two Army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy are very efficient in handling crises situation regarding national defense. when Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in process.
This setup against the vibrant backdrop of Rayalaseema, the story blends action, romance, humor, and family drama sacrifice, and the enduring power of love, friendship,
85274.cast: Keerthy Suresh, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram, Venkatesh Daggubati

85304.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
85304.synopsis: A small-town boy chasing big dreams in Mumbai turns tradition on its head when he moves into his wife's home along with his entire family - forcing two clashing households to learn what true love, respect actually is. YEH PREM MOL LIYA is set to release in theatres worldwide on November 27th, 2026.

85318.title: The Gallerist
85318.synopsis: A gallerist, driven by a desperate desire for success, hatches a scheme to cover up a dead man as an extraordinary art piece at a pretentious Miami art fair.
85318.cast: Jenna Ortega, Natalie Portman, Sterling K. Brown

85319.title: Look Back
85319.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.

85337.title: Gotta Have Faith: George Michael IMAX Early Access
85337.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience. On Wednesday, December 9 fans can be among the first to see the film by attending the Gotta Have Faith: George Michael IMAX Early Access Event Screenings and receive a Collectible Ticket.

85352.title: Babies
85352.synopsis: A happily married couple (Anna Kendrick and Seth Rogen), unsure if they want children, get a crash course in parenthood when their newly single friend and her young daughter unexpectedly move in. Their trial run exposes the funny, messy truths about parenting no one dares to say out loud--and offers a fresh look at what defines family in today's ever-changing world.
85352.cast: Anna Kendrick, Issa Rae, Seth Rogen

85358.title: The Holiday - 20th Anniversary
85358.synopsis:
In Nancy Meyers' The Holiday, a romantic comedy from the director of Something's Gotta Give and What Women Want, two 
women trade homes only to find that a change of address can change their lives. Iris (Winslet) is in love with a man who is about 
to marry another woman. Across the globe, Amanda (Diaz), realizes the man she lives with has been unfaithful. Two women 
who have never met and live 6000 miles apart, find themselves in the exact same place. They meet online at a home exchange 
website and impulsively switch homes for the holiday. Iris moves into Amanda's L.A. house in sunny California as Amanda arrives in 
the snow covered English countryside. Shortly after arriving at their destinations, both women find the last thing either wants or expects: a new romance. Amanda is 
charmed by Iris' handsome brother Graham (Law) and Iris, with inspiration provided by legendary screenwriter Arthur (Wallach), mends her heart when she meets film 
composer Miles (Black).

85373.title: Game
85373.synopsis: In late summer 1993, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills and wits unfolds after aging raver David (Marc Bessant) steals a stash of money and drugs, then crashes his car deep in the woods. Trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher (Jason Williamson) discovers him, no rescue comes?only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.

85376.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ Early Access Event
85376.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.

85387.title: Bunker
85387.synopsis: Follows a married couple of 17 years. The husband is an architect who accepts a controversial project to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. This decision leads his wife to question their marriage.
85387.cast: Javier Bardem, Penelope Cruz, Stephen Graham

85431.title: RBO - Nutcracker (2026)
85431.synopsis: Nothing says Christmas quite like The Nutcracker! The Royal Ballet celebrates the festive season with Peter Wright?s beloved ballet. Set to Tchaikovsky?s stunning score and with Julia Trevelyan Oman?s sumptuous designs, this festive classic is a treat for the whole family. *Re-release, filmed live December 10, 2025*

85433.title: In a Violent Nature Part 2
85433.synopsis: Johnny's violent rampage leads him to a summer camp just as a young, outcast camper is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party.
85433.cast: Lucas Nguyen, Olivia Scriven, Ry Barrett

85438.title: Nuisance Bear
85438.synopsis:
Winner of the U.S. Documentary Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival and hailed by Werner Herzog as 'truly groundbreaking', NUISANCE BEAR places viewers inside the world of a polar bear to deliver a cinematic pressure cooker and an urgent parable for our times. 

Filmmakers Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman follow a polar bear in Churchill, Manitoba -- the self-styled 'Polar Bear Capital of the World' -- forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers and hunters as climate change pushes it into town.
  
Guided by Inuit narrator Mike Tunalaaq Gibbons, whose perspective resists simplification, Nuisance Bear overturns the conventions of the nature documentary to ask: when a sacred predator is branded a 'nuisance,' who truly belongs in this shared landscape?

85439.title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
85439.synopsis: On NiiroCradle, where bodies are disposable and consciousness has been commoditized, four characters collide with the horrifying consequences of humanity?s attempt to transcend the flesh.

85441.title: Athi Manoharam
85441.synopsis: A police Sub-Inspector faces mounting pressures at work while struggling with personal difficulties, forcing him to balance the demands of his duty with challenges in his private life.

85443.title: 2027 Oscar-Nominated Shorts
85443.synopsis: The Oscar-Nominated Shorts will be in theaters on February 19, 2027. Showcasing the best short films from around the world, the 2027 Oscar-Nominated Shorts includes three feature-length programs, one for each Academy Award Short Film category: Animated, Documentary and Live Action.

85448.title: Minotaur Special Q&A with Dir. Andrey Zvyagintsev
85448.synopsis: Minotaur Special Q&A with Dir. Andrey Zvyagintsev.

85452.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express - Live On Stage
85452.synopsis:
Filmed live at the specially designed Starlight Auditorium?at Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE will immerse audiences in a world of speed, song and storytelling as an incredible cast of 40 whizz across the screen, performing some of musical theatre's most beloved songs.
 
As a child's train set magically comes to life and the engines race to become the fastest in the world, Rusty the steam train has little hope of winning until he is inspired by the legend of the 'Starlight Express'.
 
A show seen around the world by over 30 million people,?and with music by Andrew Lloyd Webber and lyrics by Richard Stilgoe, ANDREW LLOYD WEBBER'S STARLIGHT EXPRESS - LIVE ON STAGE is an electrifying experience for all ages.
85452.cast: Jade Marvin, Jeevan Braich, Olivia Ringrose

85482.title: Ghosted
85482.synopsis: Councilman Jamie Blake is used to leaving women in the dust--charming on the first few dates, then gone without a trace. But when he "ghosts" Arnelle, he finds himself haunted in the most literal sense.

85486.title: Mysaa (Hindi)
85486.synopsis: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

85489.title: Exhibition on Screen: Renoir & Love
85489.synopsis:
Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world's favourite artists; a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist, he is unmatched at depicting human connection. The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

85490.title: A Long Winter
85490.synopsis: In 1951, high in Colorado's Rocky Mountains, Mike's world is thrown into uncertainty when his mother vanishes into the wilderness. Alongside his complicated father, and with their small mountain community rallying together against the unforgiving winter, Mike embarks on a search that leads him toward an unexpected journey of self-discovery, belonging and the quiet strength required to carry on.
85490.cast: Caitriona Balfe, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Fred Hechinger

85500.title: THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE.
85500.synopsis:
RAYE is a songwriter, storyteller and occasional over-thinker. She writes about love, loss, faith, joy and the strange theatre of being human -- often all at once. One of the world's most celebrated artists, the South London-born singer-songwriter made history in 2024 when she won six BRIT Awards in a single night, the most by any artist ever. Her Mercury Prize-winning sophomore album, THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE. showcases her evolution as an independent artist, songwriter, composer, producer, and arranger. Now, leading with 11 nominations at the 2027 GRAMMY Awards -- matching the record for the most nominations received by a female artist in a single year -- RAYE has reached another extraordinary milestone. 
THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE. comes to theatres as a four-act musical odyssey through the seasons of life. Going far beyond the conventional concert film, RAYE draws you into a world of breathtaking intensity, where every lyric carries weight, every crescendo hits deeper and every feeling sits impossibly close. Exhilarating, heartbreaking, joyful and profoundly moving, it's a cinematic experience that holds you on every word. 
Joined on stage by 117 musicians, RAYE performs THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE. in its entirety, reimagined through extraordinary orchestral arrangements. Filmed at London's iconic Royal Albert Hall in October 2026, the film captures a night that Rolling Stone UK described as "a spectacular symphony of salvation," in a five-star review. Yet beneath the grandeur lies something deeply personal: a tangible connection between RAYE, the musicians and the audience, shared through moments of joy, heartbreak, hope and release. It's a family affair too, with RAYE joined on stage by her Grandad Michael, her sisters Amma, Absolutely and Katelyn, and her Grandma Agatha.

Brought to life by award-winning director Rohan Blair-Mangat, alongside GRAMMY-nominated production company Aldgate Pictures, creative director Mikey Robbins, and musical director Pete Clements, THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE. is an immersive cinematic spectacle infused with big-band crescendos, theatrical storytelling, and the indescribable stage presence that is uniquely RAYE's.

At its heart, the film is a celebration of family, faith, resilience and the extraordinary power of connection. A triumph in every sense, it's a testament to an artist who continues to shatter expectations, carve her own path, and remind us that music is indeed medicine.

85502.title: The Prestige: 20th Anniversary
85502.synopsis: From acclaimed filmmaker Christopher Nolan ('Memento,' 'Batman Begins'), comes a mysterious story of two magicians whose intense rivalry leads them on a life-long battle for supremacy full of obsession, deceit and jealousy with dangerous and deadly consequences.
85502.cast: Christian Bale, Hugh Jackman, Scarlett Johansson

85503.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN JAKARTA: LIVE VIEWING
85503.synopsis:
End the year with a spectacular finale: BTS LIVE in cinemas.
 
The record-breaking journey continues as BTS's history-making tour across Asia makes its way to the big screen.
 
Join BTS for the grand year-end finale in Jakarta in December and experience the breathtaking performances and electrifying energy of BTS's stadium tour.
 
Don't miss your chance to witness BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in all its glory in cinemas worldwide.

85516.title: Eternal Return
85516.synopsis: After losing her boyfriend in an accident, Cass is resigned to a life without love until she meets an enigmatic mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming.
85516.cast: Kit Harington, Naomi Scott, Sonoya Mizuno

85517.title: Paradise
85517.synopsis: Two young men set out in search of the truth about their absent fathers, one in the poor neighborhoods of Abidjan in Ivory Coast, the other in a small town in Quebec.
85517.cast: Daniel Atsu Hukporti, Joey Boivin Desmeules

85523.title: Freaks Part II
85523.synopsis: Mary and her daughter Chloe live on the road, hiding their identities from a world that wants to exterminate 'freaks' like them. Chloe's longing for a friend throws her mom's plans into chaos and unlocks secrets that have been long buried.
85523.cast: Amanda Crew, April Telek, Michael Adamthwaite

85529.title: Moulin Rouge! 25th Anniversary
85529.synopsis: When an idealistic poet (Ewan McGregor) is drawn into the dark, fantastical underworld of the Parisian nightclub the “Moulin Rouge,” he finds a seedy, glamorous haven of sex, drugs and electricity. He also finds himself plunged into a passionate love affair with the club's star, who is also the city's most famous courtesan (Nicole Kidman) in this tragic love story from filmmaker Baz Luhrmann.
85529.cast: Ewan McGregor, John Leguizamo, Nicole Kidman

85530.title: The Fox
85530.synopsis: Nick, the affable heir to a wealthy rural landowner, discovers his fiancee, Kori, is cheating on him. Desperate to save their relationship, he makes a deal with a mysterious fox who promises to transform Kori into his perfect partner. Nick pushes her into a magical hole, and she emerges seemingly everything he desires. But her increasingly bizarre behavior makes him question his decision.
85530.cast: Emily Browning, Jai Courtney, Olivia Colman

85534.title: Popiwa
85534.synopsis: Three humble friends discover a lost monkey, and when they return it in exchange for a generous reward, their lives change overnight. Suddenly rich, they dive into a world of luxury, wild adventures, and hilarious situations that put their friendship to the test.
85534.cast: Carlos Cruz, Luis Polonia, Papi Rosswil

85538.title: Romeo + Juliet 30th Anniversary
85538.synopsis: Baz Luhrmann's dazzling and unconventional adaptation of William Shakespeare's classic love story is spellbinding. Leonardo DiCaprio and Claire Danes portray Romeo and Juliet, the youthful star-crossed lovers of the past. But the setting has been moved from its Elizabethan origins to the futuristic urban backdrop of Verona Beach.
85538.cast: Claire Danes, John Leguizamo, Leonardo DiCaprio

85547.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
85547.synopsis: A labourer?s daughter in a remote village who audaciously dreams of becoming an astronaut, is forcibly married off at Seventeen, yet finds an unlikely ally in her husband who hand-holds her along the daunting path to the stars; till he becomes her final hurdle.
85547.cast: Dulquer Salman, Satvika Veeravalli, Shruti Haasan

85551.title: Many Many Happy Returns
85551.synopsis: The film centers around a group of close-knit childhood friends reuniting in their picturesque hometown for an elaborate, week-long wedding celebration. As old sparks fly and long-buried secrets surface, the joyful occasion quickly turns chaotic, forcing the friends to confront unresolved heartbreaks, career anxieties, and the changing dynamics of their relationships.

85556.title: Vrushakarma
85556.synopsis: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

85594.title: Maserati: The Brothers
85594.synopsis: The name Maserati, renowned in the world of car racing and manufacturing, is more than just that. This is the story of the Maserati family company's modest, yet proud beginning, and the journey they took for that name to become so established - from its founding in 1914, to the struggle to keep the business and their lives intact, to the legend it is today.
85594.cast: Andy Garcia, Anthony Hopkins, Jessica Alba

85597.title: Prince 3121 Las Vegas Live
85597.synopsis: Prepare for an electrifying, once in a lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.

85600.title: Ringu & Ju-On: The Grudge Double Feature
85600.synopsis: Two of Japan's most iconic horror films return to the big screen for one terrifying double feature! In RINGU, a television journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days, leading her to a chilling encounter with the vengeful spirit Sadako. In JU-ON: THE GRUDGE, a social worker enters a seemingly ordinary home, only to discover a sinister curse and the terrifying presence of Kayako. Together, these groundbreaking J-horror classics redefined the genre with their haunting imagery, relentless suspense, and unforgettable scares. Experience both films as they were meant to be seen--on the big screen.
85600.cast: Hiroyuki Sanada, Megumi Okina, Misaki Ito, Nanako Matsushima

85604.title: Everytime

85630.title: The Departed: 20th Anniversary
85630.synopsis: THE DEPARTED is set in South Boston, where the state police force is waging war on organized crime.  Young undercover cop Billy Costigan (Leonardo DiCaprio) is assigned to infiltrate the mob syndicate run by gangland chief Costello (Jack Nicholson).   While Billy is quickly gaining Costello's confidence, Colin Sullivan (Matt Damon), a hardened young criminal who has infiltrated the police department as an informer for the syndicate, is rising to a position of power in the Special Investigation Unit.  Each man becomes deeply consumed by his double life, gathering information about the plans and counter-plans of the operations he has penetrated.  But when it becomes clear to both the gangsters and the police that there's a mole in their midst, Billy and Colin are suddenly in danger of being caught and exposed to the enemy - and each must race to uncover the identity of the other man in time to save himself.

85653.title: End Of The Century: The Story of the Ramones
85653.synopsis: Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. In 1974, the New York City music scene was shocked into consciousness by the violently new and raw sound of a band of misfits from Queens called The Ramones. Playing in a seedy Bowery bar to a small group of fellow struggling musicians, the band struck a chord of disharmony that rocked the foundation of the mid-seventies music scene. This quartet of unlikely rock stars traveled across the country and around the world connecting with the disenfranchised everywhere, while sparking a movement that would resonate with two generations of outcasts across the globe. Although the band never reached the top of the Billboard charts, they managed to endure by maintaining a rigorous touring schedule for twenty-two years. 4K Re-release.
85653.cast: Dee Dee Ramone, Joey Ramone, Rick Rubin

85654.title: Bhogi

85656.title: Billy Knight

What Billy offers him is everything he's ever wanted, and the closer Alex gets, the harder it becomes to tell where Billy's world ends and his own life begins.

It highlights how kindness and compassion can bring people together, even in the most difficult situations. Gursheed Mohamad Singh is a story about humanity, love and the message that people should always come before religion.

85697.title: Rayavalasa
85697.synopsis:
Set against the nostalgic backdrop of an early 2000s Telugu village, Rayavalasa is an emotionally engaging rural drama that brings together love, friendship, family relationships, village rivalries, and unexpected twists.The story revolves around Raju, a kind-hearted young man who lives with his grandmother, cherishing his friendships and leading a simple life while carrying the emotional burden of his parents' tragic past. His peaceful world takes an unexpected turn when Rani, the village president's daughter, returns from the city with a dream of establishing a school for the village children. As their destinies become intertwined, long-standing political rivalries, jealousy, ego, and hidden agendas begin to disrupt the harmony of the village. A carefully planned conspiracy puts Raju and Rani's reputations at stake, triggering a chain of unexpected events that changes their lives forever. Caught between love, friendship, betrayal, and powerful village politics, Raju must confront injustice and fight to protect his dignity, relationships, and everything he holds dear.
Blending rooted Telugu nativity, nostalgic village celebrations, vibrant folk music, heartfelt emotions, and gripping dramatic twists, Rayavalasa promises an engaging theatrical experience that celebrates the innocence of village life while exploring the complexities of human relationships.
85697.cast: Anitha Chowdary, Karthik Jayanthi, Sreesha Nulu

transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a  powerful 
villain no one can even see. The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

85747.synopsis:
The morning after Martin Luther King Jr.'s assassination, Jane Elliott divided her all-white third-grade class in Riceville, Iowa, by eye color. Her lesson in discrimination made her a national figure and a target.

Nearly sixty years later, JANE ELLIOTT AGAINST THE WORLD finds her as funny and combative as ever. She stands with students, teachers, and families in Temecula, California, fighting restrictions on teaching race and history. At home, her daughters ask her to acknowledge what her refusal to stay silent has cost them.

The woman who spent a lifetime asking others to change must now try to change herself.

Zha is soon drawn into a fantasy world, where he embarks on a romantic journey with a beautiful female player who promises him a ticket to the moon if he can get her the money for it. Set against the backdrop of a fading film industry, acclaimed animator Xu Zao makes a formally daring debut with Light Pillar, weaving hand-drawn animation and live action into a poignant meditation on one man's search for belonging.

THOLI PREMA KATHA is an intriguing romantic mystery that explores love, destiny, identity, and unexpected twists.

Determined to reunite with his beloved, Aditya travels to Varalakshmi's village, only to face a shocking reality--she doesn't recognize him!

As Aditya struggles to uncover the truth, family conflicts, a forced marriage proposal, and mysterious revelations complicate their lives. When Varalakshmi's sister discovers that the Aditya she knew in Hyderabad is different from the man standing before her, the mystery deepens.

Who is the real Aditya? What happened in Hyderabad? Can true love survive a mystery of mistaken identity? Tholi Prema Katha promises an emotional journey filled with romance, suspense, family drama, and unexpected revelations.

As communities were divided, some people chose to stand together and help one another. Through the lives of its characters, the film explores family, faith, identity and human relationships. It highlights how kindness and compassion can bring people together, even in the most difficult situations. Gursheed Mohamad Singh is a story about humanity, love and the message that people should always come before religion.

announced.title: Tholi Prema Katha
announced.synopsis:
THOLI PREMA KATHA is an intriguing romantic mystery that explores love, destiny, identity, and unexpected twists.

Aditya and Varalakshmi's journey take a tragic turn when their bus meets with an accident. After spending 28 days in a coma, Aditya awakens with memories of a beautiful love story, a life together, and a child.

Determined to reunite with his beloved, Aditya travels to Varalakshmi's village, only to face a shocking reality--she doesn't recognize him!

As Aditya struggles to uncover the truth, family conflicts, a forced marriage proposal, and mysterious revelations complicate their lives. When Varalakshmi's sister discovers that the Aditya she knew in Hyderabad is different from the man standing before her, the mystery deepens.

Who is the real Aditya? What happened in Hyderabad? Can true love survive a mystery of mistaken identity? Tholi Prema Katha promises an emotional journey filled with romance, suspense, family drama, and unexpected revelations.
announced.cast: Ravi Varma, Satvik Varma

As circumstances take unexpected turns, Anna's return sets off a chain of events that changes everything.

announced.title: Coward
announced.synopsis: Set at the height of World War I in the shadows of the Belgian trenches, Lukas Dhont's COWARD unfolds as an epic, intimate journey of youthful self discovery through love, art, and survival. Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?
announced.cast: Emmanuel Macchia, Valentin Campagne

announced.title: Demain je tombe amoureux / Love Lessons

Once back home, Emile discovers that his wife has left him. He is now forced to apply his own precepts to himself. Three meetings then help him reinvent himself.
announced.cast: Emmanuelle Devos, Fabrice Luchini

announced.title: Look Back
announced.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.
announced.cast: Miyu Sasaki, Ryo Ikeda

announced.title: Japon - lumiere d'automne - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: Immerse yourself in the heart of a fascinating country where ancient traditions and modernity coexist in perfect harmony. From bustling metropolises like Tokyo to serene places like Kyoto, this journey unveils the many facets of the Japanese archipelago. Through encounters and discoveries, the film leads us to iconic sites steeped in history and emotion, such as Hiroshima and the sacred island of Miyajima, as well as to more peaceful regions, including the majestic landscapes of the Japanese Alps. Between ancient temples, ultramodern cities, and breathtaking panoramas bathed in the colors of autumn, our adventurers Serge and Johanne offer a sensitive and authentic perspective on Japan.

Breaking away from the grips of the brutal gang he attempts to bring down the entire organization while keeping his ex-wife and daughter safe. A lone wolf with a psychotic contract killer closing in on him, he needs to decide if his father might be the one person who can help him make a stand.

Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.

Unable to pay Zha's salary, the studio's owner offers him a virtual reality headset as partial compensation. Zha is soon drawn into a fantasy world, where he embarks on a romantic journey with a beautiful female player who promises him a ticket to the moon if he can get her the money for it. Set against the backdrop of a fading film industry, acclaimed animator Xu Zao makes a formally daring debut with Light Pillar, weaving hand-drawn animation and live action into a poignant meditation on one man's search for belonging.

announced.title: Exhibition on Screen: Renoir & Love

The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

announced.title: Ringu & Ju-On: The Grudge Double Feature

In RINGU, a television journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days, leading her to a chilling encounter with the vengeful spirit Sadako. In JU-ON: THE GRUDGE, a social worker enters a seemingly ordinary home, only to discover a sinister curse and the terrifying presence of Kayako. Together, these groundbreaking J-horror classics redefined the genre with their haunting imagery, relentless suspense, and unforgettable scares. Experience both films as they were meant to be seen--on the big screen.

Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.

announced.title: The Comeback King
announced.synopsis:
The film, about a country western star in free fall, is set to star Glen Powell and Cristin Milioti. Judd Apatow will direct. Apatow and Powell wrote the script together.

Apatow will produce through his longstanding Apatow Productions overall deal with the Studio. Apatow's relationship with the Studio dates back to his 2005 directorial debut, The 40-Year-Old Virgin, and he has since directed Knocked Up, Funny People, This is 40, Trainwreck and The King of Staten Island for the Studio.

Powell and Dan Cohen will produce through Barnstorm's first look deal with the Studio. Powell's relationship with the Studio originates with his starring role in Twisters, which overperformed against all industry expectations, becoming the biggest opening for a natural disaster film ever at the domestic box office and grossing $267.8 million overall in the domestic box office.

Kevin Misher will produce through Misher Films. Misher has a storied history with Universal Pictures, where he was President of Production from 1996-2001 and supervised production for some of the Studio's most acclaimed features, including Erin Brockovich, The Fast and the Furious, Meet the Parents, and The Mummy. Misher subsequently formed Misher Films, where he has been producing a variety of films over the past two decades, including Fighting With My Family, Coming 2 America and You People.

announced.synopsis: CORPUS follows Sayo, a soulful nightlife photographer and small-time drug dealer in New York City in 1998. When Vince, his longtime crush and a rising movie star, invites him to a party upstate, the two set off with their rowdy friend Ross for a remote country manor and a weekend of debauchery. There they meet three mysterious women, and what begins as seduction gives way to manipulation, paranoia and something far stranger.
announced.cast: Brodie Townsend, Jeff Wahlberg, Michael Vlamis

announced.title: CoComelon: The Movie
announced.synopsis:
The CG animated feature, inspired by the global children's phenomenon CoComelon, is produced by Moonbug Entertainment, Flywheel Media, Prime Focus Studios, and DreamWorks Animation, with animation by the DNEG Group. The film is directed by acclaimed animation filmmaker Kat Good (Tarzan, Mulan, Kung Fu Panda), with Grammy-nominated, multi-platinum songwriter and producer Justin Tranter serving as Executive Music Producer. 

Created exclusively for the theatrical experience, the big-screen adventure invites families to experience the world of CoComelon like never before, following JJ and his friends on a sweeping cinematic journey filled with rich storytelling and original music that will captivate audiences when the film premieres in theaters on February 19, 2027.
announced.cast: Ike Barinholtz, Nicholas Hoult, Sza

announced.title: Babies
announced.synopsis: A happily married couple (Anna Kendrick and Seth Rogen), unsure if they want children, get a crash course in parenthood when their newly single friend and her young daughter unexpectedly move in. Their trial run exposes the funny, messy truths about parenting no one dares to say out loud--and offers a fresh look at what defines family in today's ever-changing world.
announced.cast: Anna Kendrick, Issa Rae, Seth Rogen
